title: Pre-register a GQ-010 baseline BEFORE merges change the graph
evidence: GQ-010's own evidence_gaps[0]: no agreed baseline exists for evidence-retrieval time or decision changes.

spec.description: GQ-010 has no baseline, so nothing downstream of it is measurable. This is TIME-CRITICAL in a way the other tasks are not: once the merges land, today's graph is gone and the before-picture cannot be reconstructed.
spec.context: Pre-register 5 real decisions and time them against TODAY's graph before any merge changes it. Pre-registration must be frozen before the first measurement, and the module's own experimental-method.md makes the point that a Git commit should not replace an external preregistration - timestamp it somewhere not controlled by the analyst. Without this, any later claim that the work improved retrieval or decision quality is unfalsifiable. Current main records a baseline observation, but not five externally timestamped pre-registered decisions and a frozen protocol. Before-merge acceptance is not established. Obtain the original required evidence or define a prospective successor with the research owner; do not relabel later observations as preregistration.
acceptance_criteria: 5 decisions pre-registered with their measurement protocol frozen before the first timing
